title: The all-degree etale hypercover condition without splitting
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $U_\bullet$ a simplicial object of its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], hence an augmented simplicial $X$-scheme. It is an etale hypercover if, for every $n\geq0$, the matching scheme $M_n(U)$ (the universal scheme over $X$ with compatible projections to all lower simplices, as in [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover]) exists in the small etale site and the canonical map $U_n\to M_n(U)$ is surjective etale. The canonical map composes with each matching projection to the corresponding simplex map. The matching universal property is tested on all schemes over $X$. In degree zero $M_0(U)=X$. No splitting or finiteness condition is imposed.
